case_name: Sanjay Sharma vs Smt Rajni Alias Nirmala
facts_of_case: Appellant Sanjay Sharma filed a petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 against his wife seeking divorce due to her cruel behavior and desertion.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging cruelty to prove that the other party has been treated with such cruelty as to render the continued cohabitation intolerable.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the behaviour of the respondent towards the appellant was very cruel and the respondent had lodged false cases against the appellant which were ultimately dismissed.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to maintain the other party, especially when the latter is in a vulnerable state, can be considered as desertion.
legal_principles.held: The respondent had left the appellant alone when he was ill and had not fulfilled her matrimonial obligation.

outcome.final_order: The Family Court rejected the petition for divorce. The appellant's appeal was also dismissed.
